facts.big: It’s + adjective · It’s going to rain
facts.label: O tempo
facts.sub: Use It’s hot, It’s sunny, It’s cloudy para o agora e It’s going to rain para o futuro. Pergunte What’s the weather like today?

facts.label: Descrever
facts.sub: Para descrever o tempo, use It’s + adjetivo: It’s hot, It’s sunny, It’s cloudy, It’s warm. Sempre use it no começo. Não diga Is hot nem It makes hot.

facts.label: Perguntar
facts.sub: Para perguntar, diga What’s the weather like today? A resposta é It’s hot and sunny. Também dá para dizer Is it cold? e responder Yes, it is ou No, it isn’t.

paragraphs: It is Thursday afternoon on a street in Miami. The sun is bright and the air is warm. Rui walks along the sidewalk. He looks up at the sky. His neighbor Jack waves from a bench. Jack asks about the weather.
“Hey, Rui! What’s the weather like today?” says Jack. “It’s hot and sunny, but it’s going to rain later.” says Rui. “Really? How do you know?” says Jack.
